slice.name: M token held by Mantra USD

name: Mantra USD
oneLiner: MANTRA's dollar wraps M0's M; public conversion is to wM, and a single externally owned address controls token upgrades.
collateral: M0 M tokens held by the chain-local extension; the M parent provides the Treasury-backed issuance and custody layer.
pegMechanism: M-extension wrapping and unwrapping conserve the deposited M claim. The current SwapFacility restricts direct M output to approved swappers: an unprivileged sample address qualified to swap the child token into wM but not directly into M. This is technical conversion eligibility, not a sent transaction or a cash redemption right.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact deployed MYieldToOne extension holds M and issues a fixed-face child claim. It inherits the M parent Treasury-backed archetype; the local token is not a direct Treasury fund share and holders have no automatic yield entitlement.

proofOfReserves.provider: On-chain parent-token custody; not independent financial assurance

dependencyReview.rationale: At MANTRA block 18858665, hash 0x3b827926013ded60b6eb0f1702689a63b7668ae0bb0511887dffa1cbcb4a67be, timestamp 2026-10-15T10:35:30Z, symbol/decimals and EIP-1967 implementation/admin were re-read. Local backing balance was 440,148.155415 M against 434,703.845695 mantraUSD supply. The verified implementation transfers M before minting and burns the matching nominal child amount on unwrap. The unprivileged sample canSwapViaPath(0x1,child,wM) returned true and child-to-M returned false; SwapFacility paused() was false. These calls establish conditional technical path eligibility, not a sent transaction, measured full-position capacity or a cash-redemption right. The exact deployment transaction establishes the 2025-10-27 launch boundary. The 2025-12-12 Guardian report covers named framework commits and is not certification of this deployment or financial reserves.

relationships.reason: The immediate serial claim is the verified parent stablecoin, not a direct child allocation of off-chain Treasury reserves.
